known_defects.detail: 1 ambiguous label owner. Measured on evidence/v2-lan/v2-lan-frames-pinned.txt frame 0: the label 'no committed rate' spans columns 30-46 of row 31, centre (38,31). Its own route (rtr -> fios) is the vertical stem at column 28, 10 cells from the centre; the competing wlp -> rtr straight run occupies row 24 and passes through column 38, 7 cells from the centre, so another route is closer than its own. Label placement had no unambiguous alternative in this geometry: the rtr -> fios route is a 4-cell vertical, and a 17-cell label placed beside a vertical run is offset 9 cells while the two converging LAN runs sit 7 rows below.

the control palette (columns 1-9, rows 40-45) overlaps the bottom node: the CF box occupies columns 7-26, rows 38-41, so its lower-left border at columns 7-9, rows 40-41 is painted over (evidence/v4-wan/v4-wan-text.txt rows 40-41). The 40-row chain is centred in a 46-row area and lands on the palette band; the validator does not test this, a reader sees it.
40 of 46 rows used; a taller chain would not fit, so no further hop can be added to this view.

phase-0 dots sit on the first dot cell the router allocated, which is one cell beyond the port stem cell (e.g. v2-lan frame 0 dot at (28,15) under the host port stem at (28,14); v4-wan frame 0 dot at (8,19) under the ONT port stem at (8,18)). The check's origins line reads full for every animated view, so under the renderer's own definition the dot starts at its arrow origin; a reader sees it one cell past the box border.
